concerns.text: Task T009 (full statistical enrichment analysis) consumes a complete SNP‑TF scoring dataset, but the plan never produces such a dataset. Only a thin sample (`data/derived/sample_scores.parquet` from T007) is generated, leaving the required full `scores.parquet` artifact missing before T009.

Task T013 verifies reproducibility by re‑running the full pipeline, yet the full pipeline execution task T016 (which actually generates the final artefacts) is scheduled **after** T013. The verification therefore runs before the artefacts exist, violating the producer‑before‑consumer ordering.

Task T008 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it mutates `data/derived/filtered_snps.parquet` in place to add the `is_gwas_lead` column. In‑place modification of a shared file is not safe for parallel execution, so the `[P]` tag is inaccurate.
